observations: Two stacked white plastic IBC tanks with metal frames.
The tanks show visible dirt, algae, and some discoloration, especially on the lower tank.
The lower tank has a blue spigot and a white cap on the side.
The upper tank has a white spigot and a blue cap.
Both tanks have labels with text and symbols, but the text is not legible.
The tanks are placed on a concrete floor next to a wall with moss and stains.
The metal frames show rust and wear, especially at the base and corners.
The lower tank has a visible label with '22.5kg max' and 'JIT' written on it, but the text is partially obscured.
The tanks appear to be used and may have been previously filled with water or chemicals.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
